analyzed_vuln.description: Heap UAF is caused by cmsWriteTag replacing an existing tag via _cmsNewTag/_cmsDeleteTagByPos without checking aliasing between the old stored tag object and the new input pointer. In this PoV, SetTextTags writes cmsSigProfileDescriptionTag/cmsSigCopyrightTag multiple times on the same profile; the second write passes a cmsMLU pointer that is still referenced by the profile tag table, _cmsDeleteTagByPos frees it, and cmsWriteTag then duplicates from the now-freed pointer (via DupPtr), leaving corrupted/freed-backed data later consumed in transform optimization (eventually read in TetrahedralInterpFloat).
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Triggered through cms_transform_fuzzer when malformed profile data drives cmsCreateTransform down a path that repeatedly builds virtual Lab profiles (cmsCreateLab2ProfileTHR -> SetTextTags -> cmsWriteTag) and rewrites an already-present text tag using a pointer that aliases the currently stored tag object. Required condition: same tag signature rewritten on a profile with data pointer referring to the existing tag allocation, so _cmsDeleteTagByPos frees it before DupPtr reads it, creating use-after-free state that is later dereferenced during CLUT interpolation.
